subject: XS: implement the `io` vtable capability group (addfile/filehandles) — Digest::MD5 files.t blocked on it
description: The last optional pclxs group PCL doesn't implement (ABI 5's io_* read/write consumers). Bridge reports it cleanly: "this host does not implement filehandles (vtable capability group 'io' is absent)". Blocks Digest::MD5's ->addfile (its files.t) and any XS that reads PerlIO. See docs/xs-abi5-and-destroy.md + pclxs pclxs_host.h io group docs. All-or-nothing group like magic.
